name: Audible
description: Audible is an audiobook and audio entertainment streaming platform operated as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc.

stock.note: Audible does not have its own stock ticker as it is a wholly-owned subsidiary of public parent Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN).

marketing_spend.derivation: Estimated using a 15% to 20% marketing-to-revenue ratio typical for consumer subscription and audio streaming software platforms, applied against Audible's estimated annual revenue of $200 million.

business_updates.headline: Amazon completes tender offer and acquisition of Audible as a wholly-owned subsidiary
